description:
A career at Auto-Owners is challenging and rewarding.  Our group of caring associates create financial security by helping individuals and businesses make a new start when a loss occurs.
 
 Job Description 
 
 
 We offer a merit-based work-from-home program based on job responsibilities. After initial training in-person, this specific role could have the flexibility to work from home up to 3 days per week. 

 Please note that we are not currently hiring fully remote positions. Our tech office for this role is in Lansing, Michigan only. 

 Auto-Owners Insurance, a top-rated insurance carrier, is seeking a web developer to join our Analytics Web Systems team. This role will focus on developing and supporting .NET applications and integrations that connect AWS-hosted services and data with on-premises systems.
Responsibilities include developing, maintaining, and supporting software applications for new and existing systems. The position requires the person to:
 Design, develop, test, and maintain applications and services using C# and .NET
 Develop and support integrations between AWS services and on-premises applications, APIs, and databases
 Build and maintain REST APIs and service-to-service integrations
 Develop and support .NET applications using AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and IAM
 Troubleshoot application and integration issues across AWS and on-premises environments
 Work with SQL Server and SQL-based data integrations
 Implement secure and reliable application communication using appropriate authentication, authorization, secrets management, logging, error handling, and resiliency patterns
 Write automated tests and develop clean, maintainable code within a shared codebase
 Work with Infrastructure as Code to deploy and maintain AWS resources
 Effectively communicate and collaborate with developers, platform engineers, business partners, and other technical teams
 Identify and recommend opportunities to improve application reliability, maintainability, and development processes
 
 Desired Skills and Experience 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
 Strong professional experience developing applications using C# and .NET
 Experience developing backend services, REST APIs, or system integrations
 Professional experience developing or supporting applications in AWS
 Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM
 Strong understanding of object-oriented design and modern software development best practices
 Experience with relational databases and SQL, preferably SQL Server
 Experience with automated testing, Git, and CI/CD practices
 Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, SAM, Terraform, or similar tools
 Experience with containerized .NET applications, serverless or event-driven architectures, API security, or production application monitoring
 
 Benefits 

 Auto-Owners offers a wide range of career opportunities, and we are seeking talent that will help us continue our long tradition of success. We offer a friendly work environment, structured training program, employee mentoring and an excellent compensation/benefits package. Along with a competitive base salary, matched 401(k), fully-funded pension plan (once vested), and bonus programs, Auto-Owners also provides generous paid time off including holidays, vacation days, personal time, and sick leave. If you're looking to do rewarding work alongside great people, Auto-Owners is the place for you!

 Equal Employment Opportunity 

 Auto-Owners Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. The Company hires, transfers, and promotes on the basis of ability, without consideration of disability, age, sex, race, color, religion, height, weight, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, or any factor contrary to federal, state or local law.

 *Please note that the ability to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship is a requirement.
